title: Villager Coin Loot for Better Archeology
description: Adds Copper, Iron, and Gold coins from VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod to the loot tables of Pandarix's Better Archeology mod.
body:
_This project will be deprecated in favor of the new built-in integration options._

Adds Copper, Iron, and Gold coins from VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod to the loot tables of Pandarix's Better Archeology mod.

## Requirements

*   VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod
*   Pandarix's Better Archeology mod

## Installation

1.  Download the ZIP file for your desired Minecraft version.
2.  Create your Minecraft World.
3.  Install the ZIP file in your Minecraft World's `datapacks` folder.
